mapper.sql: id, assets_id,status, goods_code, goods_name, bar_code,goods_image,package_specification ,package_specification_num,package_unit,package_quantity,order_quantity, surplus_quantity,surplus_package_quantity,presale_activity_id,presale_activity_no,begin_order_date,end_order_date,creator,org_code,biz_org_code, create_time, updater, update_time, is_delete
mapper.update:
update ord_dis_presale_assets_detail set surplus_quantity = surplus_quantity + #{updateSurplusQuantity},
order_quantity = order_quantity + #{orderQuantity} , package_quantity = order_quantity DIV #{packageSpecificationNum},
update_time = now(), updater = #{loginUsername} where presale_activity_id = #{presaleActivityId} and assets_id = #{assetsId} and goods_code = #{goodsCode}
and surplus_quantity - abs(#{updateSurplusQuantity}) >= 0
update ord_dis_presale_assets_detail set status = #{updateStatus},updater = #{loginUsername},update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{nowStatus}
mapper.select: select d.id,d.status, d.assets_id, d.goods_code, d.goods_name, d.bar_code,d.package_specification,d.package_specification_num ,d.package_quantity,d.order_quantity, d.surplus_quantity,d.presale_activity_id,d.presale_activity_no,d.begin_order_date,d.end_order_date from ord_dis_presale_assets_detail d inner join ord_dis_presale_assets pa on pa.id = d.assets_id where pa.store_code = #{storeCode} and d.goods_code = #{goodsCode} and #{orderCreateTime} between d.begin_order_date and d.end_order_date and d.is_delete = 0

select d.id, d.goods_code, d.goods_name, d.bar_code,d.goods_image,d.package_specification,d.package_unit, ROUND(d.surplus_quantity / d.package_specification_num,2) as surplus_package_quantity, d.package_quantity,d.goods_image, d.order_quantity,d.surplus_quantity,d.presale_activity_id,d.presale_activity_no,d.begin_order_date,d.end_order_date from ord_dis_presale_assets pa inner join ord_dis_presale_assets_detail d on d.assets_id = pa.id where pa.store_code = #{storeCode} and d.is_delete = 0 order by end_order_date desc,presale_activity_no desc
select id from ord_dis_presale_assets_detail where (now() > begin_order_date and status = 'notStarted') or (now() > end_order_date and status = 'ordering')

select d.id, d.status, d.assets_id, d.goods_code, d.goods_name, d.bar_code, d.package_specification, d.package_specification_num , d.package_quantity, d.order_quantity, d.surplus_quantity, d.presale_activity_id, d.presale_activity_no, d.begin_order_date, d.package_unit, d.end_order_date from ord_dis_presale_assets_detail d inner join ord_dis_presale_assets pa on pa.id = d.assets_id where pa.store_code = #{storeCode} and d.goods_code = #{goodsCode} and d.presale_activity_no = #{presaleActivityNo} and d.is_delete = 0

select d.id, d.status, d.assets_id, d.goods_code, d.goods_name, d.bar_code, d.package_specification, d.package_specification_num, d.package_unit, d.package_quantity, d.order_quantity, d.surplus_quantity, d.presale_activity_id, d.presale_activity_no, d.begin_order_date, d.end_order_date from ord_dis_presale_assets_detail d inner join ord_dis_presale_assets pa on pa.id = d.assets_id where pa.store_code = #{storeCode} and d.goods_code = #{goodsCode} and d.is_delete = 0

select d.id, d.status, d.assets_id, d.goods_code, d.goods_name, d.bar_code, d.package_specification, d.package_specification_num, d.package_unit, d.package_quantity, d.order_quantity, d.surplus_quantity, d.presale_activity_id, d.presale_activity_no, d.begin_order_date, d.end_order_date from ord_dis_presale_assets_detail d inner join ord_dis_presale_assets pa on pa.id = d.assets_id where pa.store_code = #{storeCode} and d.status = 'ordering' and d.is_delete = 0
